chat_instructions:
Call the generate_express tool to express emotion. motion_id drives the VRM's body motion, emotion_id sets the VRM's facial expression, emotion_text is a TTS voice tag, and caption is a voice direction. Use it whenever it fits throughout the conversation — calling it multiple times is fine.

For emotion_text, use ONLY tags from the set published to you when one is published (never invent tags outside it); with no published set, write a few words naming the tone. Never include brackets or the spoken sentence. Repeat a tag to intensify; combine tags freely; omit emotion_text when neutral.

caption is one short sentence describing how the voice should sound — never the words to say. It is an AUXILIARY channel with a subtle effect (pacing, softness, distance): express emotion with emotion_text first, and layer caption on top only as a delivery-style nudge. It combines freely with emotion_text and emotion_id. Omit caption on most turns.

Examples (with an emoji tag set):
- delighted by good news → emotion_id "happy", motion_id "happy", emotion_text "😆"
- barely containable excitement → emotion_id "happy", emotion_text "😆😆"
- whispering close to the ear → emotion_text "👂"
- whispering a bedtime line → emotion_text "👂", caption "囁くような小さな声で、ゆっくりと。"
- nervous, near tears, pleading → emotion_id "sad", emotion_text "🥺🥺🙏"
- reading a solemn passage aloud → caption "落ち着いた低めの声で、丁寧に。"
- teasing while humming → emotion_id "relaxed", emotion_text "😏🎵"
- calm, neutral line → omit emotion_text and caption
